about.title: About New Green Landscaping
text: We do more than just cut grass—we are on a mission to raise the standard of the landscaping industry in the Greater Houston area.

New Green Landscaping was started in 2020 when I was just 16 years old. Now, at 19 and heading into my second full lawn care season, my goal has never been clearer: to provide the absolute best lawn care and landscape service possible by professionalizing the industry.

I noticed that too many homeowners were dealing with unreturned phone calls, messy job sites, and unreliable crews. I knew we could do better. Your yard isn’t just another job site to us—it’s a reflection of our standard.
